<div class="card-body">
'''Kintan Strider''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">キンタン・ストライダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手のキャラクターが没収されたか、ロストした直後に使う。１フォース消費して自分のキャラクターの１名を復活させる。ロストデッキの中からもっとも上にあるキャラクターを１人、手札に戻すこと。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デジャリックのホログラムに登場する獰猛な生物で、驚異的な治癒能力を持っている。故郷のキンタンでは絶滅しているが、ハット人のギャングたちが護衛に使用している。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Kintan Strider.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after an opponent's character is forfeited or lost. Spend 1 Force to revive one of your characters: return the character closest to the top of the Lost Pile to your hand.

'''Lore:''' A ferocious creature appearing in a dejarik hologram, with remarkable healing abilities. Extinct on its homeworld of Kintan, it is used for protection by Hutt gangsters.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to revive a character and return the topmost character from the Lost Pile to hand; the English uses the term regenerate and specifies retrieving the character closest to the top of your Lost Pile.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Kintan Strider]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="psa">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.</ref>
